subject.title: retry.provider fields split across settings scopes are silently dropped (deepMergeSettings shallow-merges nested objects)

question: Should OpenClaw accept recursive plain-object merging for nested settings scopes here, and which linked PR should be the single landing path for this bug?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and narrow, but the repair changes compatibility-sensitive settings merge behavior and there are multiple open candidate PRs with different proof and test tradeoffs.

options.title: Land one recursive fix
options.body: Accept the helper's documented recursive semantics, choose one candidate PR as canonical, and port any better proof or tests before merge.

options.title: Narrow to retry.provider
options.body: Ask contributors to limit the behavior change to the observed `retry.provider` nested fields if maintainers want the smallest upgrade footprint.

options.title: Pause for settings policy
options.body: Hold the linked PRs until maintainers define whether nested settings objects should merge recursively or replace wholesale.

recommendation.title: Land one recursive fix
recommendation.body: Accept the helper's documented recursive semantics, choose one candidate PR as canonical, and port any better proof or tests before merge.
